rule: A green validator is evidence only for the obligations it explicitly checks. Do not infer coverage of unlisted semantics or runtime behavior.

checks: Generated README/START_HERE/Current-00/Current-01 are byte-identical to renderer output from Current/CURRENT_STATE.json.
Generated bootstrap/takeover files expose the current handover-preparation route stored in Current/CURRENT_STATE.json.
does_not_check: whether an arbitrary uncommitted handover response contains truthful current facts

checks: Current-state/controller/lineage consistency
canonical path existence
Knowledge topic routing/orphans
runtime metadata-chain consistency
Canonical handover prompt exists
CURRENT_STATE points to the canonical handover prompt
README/START_HERE/Current-01 expose the handover route
machine and human Knowledge Maps expose chat_handover
Document Authority registers exactly one CURRENT_HANDOVER_WORKFLOW authority
answerability suite contains the explicit handover trigger case
handover prompt retains required two-part output/runtime/fresh-state contract
does_not_check: Truth of the future handover response before it is produced
GitHub Actions run status at the moment a future user triggers handover

checks: Actual SHA-256 of every profile listed in Current/ARTIFACT_EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY.json
actual SHA-256 and size of each linked raw LogOutput.log
agreement with runtime INDEX and embedded analysis source SHA
does_not_check: whether a rejected artifact should be promoted
historical artifacts not listed in the integrity index

checks: S1.42AC authoritative runtime-log SHA metadata chain
repository-wide qualification of the known superseded S1.42AC SHA
scan_scope: repository text files with supported suffixes
does_not_check: Other future known-bad values unless added elsewhere

checks: Central known-bad-value registry across repository text
duplicate same-level current authority claims
orphan Knowledge topics
generated-file protection markers
does_not_check: arbitrary unknown bad values not registered

checks: Future per-phase checkpoint monotonicity
predecessor PASS
checkpoint immutability
completion-commit existence
produced artifacts present in completion commit
scan_scope: Git history for those checkpoint paths/commits
does_not_check: Retroactively prove the legacy 2026 overhaul phase 3-10 completion order

checks: Frozen pre-overhaul contract obligations
backup-before-structural-migration provenance
historical/completion classifications required by the original overhaul contract
Semantic routing for the maintained answerability case suite, including the explicit new-chat handover query
does_not_check: questions absent from the case suite

checks: Representative negative fixtures fail as required: unqualified bad SHA, duplicate authority, orphan topic, phase without predecessor; registered historical SHA passes
does_not_check: Formal proof that every validator branch is covered
